title: SambaGraph: Action-Reaction Spatio-Temporal Graphs for Soccer Tactical Response Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.25569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Soccer tactics are interactive: an attacking action changes the opponent's defensive problem, and the observed response depends on the multi-agent match state. We introduce SambaGraph, an action--reaction spatio-temporal graph dataset and benchmark for soccer tactical response modeling. From tracking and event data for all 64 matches of the 2022 FIFA World Cup, we curate 4,070 action-centered episodes represented as temporally aligned 23-node player--ball graph sequences with attack/defense views, response labels, and 26,270 split-safe attack--defense pairs. We study three questions: whether observed responses can be classified from graph episodes, whether successful defenses can be retrieved for a query attack, and whether graph-derived summaries support grounded LLM reasoning. A compact signature MLP obtains $0.796\pm0.007$ macro-F1 for response classification, while a fused graph--signature dual encoder reaches $0.471\pm0.029$ Hit@5 a

translated_title: SambaGraph：用于足球战术响应建模的“动作—反应”时空图
translated_abstract: 足球战术是交互性的：一次进攻动作会改变对手面临的防守难题，而观察到的响应则取决于多智能体的比赛状态。我们提出了SambaGraph，一个用于足球战术响应建模的“动作—反应”时空图数据集与基准。基于2022年卡塔尔世界杯全部64场比赛的追踪数据与事件数据，我们精心构建了4,070个以动作为中心的比赛片段，表示为时间对齐的23节点球员—球图序列，包含进攻/防守双视图、响应标签以及26,270个安全划分的进攻—防守配对。我们研究了三个问题：能否从图片段中对观察到的响应进行分类；能否针对查询的进攻检索出成功的防守案例；以及图衍生的摘要能否支持有据可依的大语言模型推理。一个紧凑的签名MLP在响应分类任务上取得了0.796±0.007的宏F1分数，而融合图与签名的双编码器达到了0.471±0.029的Hit@5检索性能。
tldr: 本文提出了SambaGraph数据集与基准，基于2022年世界杯全部64场比赛的追踪数据构建“动作—反应”时空图，用于足球战术响应建模，涵盖响应分类、成功防守检索以及图摘要支持的大语言模型推理三项任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SambaGraph, an action-reaction spatio-temporal graph dataset and benchmark built from tracking data of all 64 matches of the 2022 FIFA World Cup, enabling soccer tactical response modeling through response classification, successful defense retrieval, and grounded LLM reasoning.
